card.name: Just before small measurement numbers
card.fires_on: Spaces, "approximately", "nearest" or "as" right before a small size or volume number such as 0.01 mL or 3 to 11 mm. Seen in lab procedures, dilution steps and descriptions of small animal sizes.

modes.label: Before a volume or size
modes.description: A space or hedge word like "approximately" or "nearest" sits just before a small mL or mm figure.

modes.label: Size comparison or tool
modes.description: The word "as" or "a" comes before a size comparison or a small tool or object.

card.writes: It seems to push toward small-object and measurement words like pin, pins and bead, and away from container words like bottle.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to give a tiny measurement, such as a drop size or a few millimetres.
